info.name: News Mail
info.summary: Mails each News user their unread entries, one mail per feed, and marks them read
info.description: Each News user gets a mail per feed listing that feed's unread entries, sent from Nextcloud's own address, and the entries are marked read in News once it has gone out. News fetches new entries unread, so each feed update's go out once. Every News user with an email address gets them; there is no setting.
info.author: Parker Wahle
